warmup: Each final question embedded/retrieved and scored before profiling; LLM warmup separate
rerank_scope: 10 pair tokenization+one batched cross-encoder inference+deterministic sorting+first3 ID selection
two_stage_scope: calculated as measured shared dense cost plus measured reranker overhead within the same repetition
LLM_generation: Wall-clock inference only; tokenization excluded; saved separately in final_results.jsonl
